Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
A few practical basics can make getting started easier:
Foundation: A box spring isn’t required. Use a firm, flat foundation; with slats, keep gaps no wider than 3 inches. Avoid placing the mattress directly on the floor.
Protector: A waterproof protector is optional, but we recommend one to help guard against spills and moisture. Liquid damage isn’t covered by the mattress warranty.
Give it time: It can take a few weeks to adjust to a new mattress. Most mattresses include a 100-night sleep trial, with at least 30 nights requested before starting a return. See trial details.

How do I use it properly the very first time?
For a new Serenade mattress:
Put it on a firm, flat foundation—not directly on the floor. If using slats, keep them no more than 3 inches apart.
Unbox it as soon as you can, then let it fully expand before using it. You don’t need to air it out first; a slight natural-material scent may fade over a few days.
It’s one-sided, so don’t flip it. Rotating it head-to-foot every 3–4 months can help promote even wear.
